novel_features.name: Local render history
novel_features.description: See every past TTS render with its text, model, voice, byte count, and cost.
novel_features.rationale: Fish Audio has no server-side history endpoint; the local SQLite render log is the only record of what you generated and what it cost.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to recover what was already rendered before spending credit again.

novel_features.name: Grouped spend report
novel_features.description: Total Fish Audio spend grouped by voice, model, or day for a side-by-side with your ElevenLabs invoice.
novel_features.rationale: Requires aggregating the local render log; no wallet endpoint breaks spend down by voice or day.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for it when the question is 'what did this voice cost us this month'.

novel_features.name: Skip identical re-renders
novel_features.description: Hash the request and reuse a prior identical render instead of paying for it again.
novel_features.rationale: Requires the local render log keyed by request hash; the API re-bills every call.
novel_features.example: fish-audio-pp-cli tts render --text "Hi, this is Pearl." --voice 802e3bc2b27e49c2995d23ef70e6ac89 --out greeting.mp3 --skip-if-rendered --agent
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it in iteration loops where most lines have not changed.

novel_features.name: Clone fidelity check
novel_features.description: Render a reference phrase with a cloned voice, transcribe it back, and report word-error-rate.
novel_features.rationale: Chains TTS and ASR with local WER math; neither endpoint alone gives a quality number.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Run it before swapping a production voice to a new clone.

novel_features.name: Pre-batch budget guard
novel_features.description: Estimate a batch's cost against your live API credit and refuse to start if it would overdraw.
novel_features.rationale: Joins the live wallet balance with local per-line cost estimates before any render is sent.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it for unattended batch jobs so a long script cannot fail halfway on credit.

novel_features.name: Compare two renders
novel_features.description: Show the cost, model, and byte deltas between two past renders.
novel_features.rationale: Requires two rows from the local render log; the API has no render identity at all.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it when picking between two takes of the same line.

narrative.headline: Fish Audio text-to-speech, voice cloning, and transcription from the terminal, with a local render log that tracks every byte and dollar the API never records.
narrative.value_prop: Render text to audio files, clone a voice from a sample, design a voice from a prompt, and transcribe audio, all with agent-friendly JSON output. Every render lands in a local SQLite log so you can skip duplicate renders, report spend by voice or model, and verify a clone's fidelity before it goes live.
narrative.auth_narrative: Set FISH_AUDIO_API_KEY (from https://fish.audio/app/api-keys) or store it with `fish-audio-pp-cli auth set-token`. The `model` header selects the TTS model (s1, s2-pro, s2.1-pro, s2.1-pro-free); the CLI validates it because the API silently falls back to s2.1-pro on typos.

quickstart.comment: confirm the key and API reachability
find a public voice by description

quickstart.command: fish-audio-pp-cli tts render --text "Hi, this is Pearl. How can I help?" --voice 802e3bc2b27e49c2995d23ef70e6ac89 --out greeting.mp3
quickstart.comment: render one line to a file and log its cost
clone a voice from a reference clip
see what you have spent so far

troubleshoots.symptom: audio sounds like a different model than requested
troubleshoots.fix: The API falls back to s2.1-pro on unknown model strings; run `fish-audio-pp-cli tts resolve --voice 7f92f8afb8ec43bf81429cc1c9199cb1 --model s2.1-pro` to validate before rendering.
Run `fish-audio-pp-cli wallet balance`; dev API credit and subscription package are separate ledgers.
`<|speaker:N|>` tags need an S2-family model; pass `--model s2.1-pro`.
Concurrency is capped by spend tier (5/15/50 slots); lower `--concurrency` on `tts batch`.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when an agent needs to turn text into audio files, clone or design a voice, transcribe audio, or account for Fish Audio spend. It is the right tool for scripted, repeatable rendering with cost tracking and for verifying a cloned voice before production use.
anti_triggers: Do not use it for live conversational voice agents or phone calls; that is Fish Audio's Agents product, out of scope here.
Do not use it for dubbing, music, or sound-effect generation; Fish Audio has no such endpoints.
Do not use it for real-time WebSocket streaming playback; use the official SDK.

recipes.title: Render a greeting and check its cost
recipes.command: fish-audio-pp-cli tts render --text "Hi, this is Pearl." --voice 802e3bc2b27e49c2995d23ef70e6ac89 --out greeting.mp3 --agent --select file,bytes,cost_usd,model
recipes.explanation: Writes the file and returns only the fields an agent needs to log.

recipes.title: Batch a script with a budget guard
recipes.explanation: Refuses to start if the estimated cost exceeds live API credit.

recipes.title: Verify a clone before going live
recipes.explanation: Reports word-error-rate from a TTS-then-ASR round trip.

recipes.title: Find a public voice
recipes.command: fish-audio-pp-cli voice discover --query "calm British male" --limit 5 --agent --select id,title,languages
recipes.explanation: Searches the cached public catalog with FTS.

clone a voice from this clip
